query: How do you build a community around your business?
direct_answer: A business community is a group of customers, fans or peers who meet, talk and help each other around what a business does, in a space the business hosts. Researchers call the brand version a brand community: “a specialized, non-geographically bound community, based on a structured set of social relations among admirers of a brand” (Muniz and O’Guinn, 2001).
